🔥 ai-telephony-demo | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enable developers to create and deploy AI-powered voice agents capable of interacting over traditional phone lines.
✨ Key Features: • Build AI telephony agents • Handle inbound and outbound calls • Local agent execution • SIP trunk configuration • Integration with VideoSDK Agent
📖 Summary: This repository allows you to build and deploy a fully functional AI telephony agent. It guides you through setting up an agent locally and configuring it to handle live inbound and outbound phone calls using VideoSDK and Google's Gemini model.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ VeraCrypt | C
🎯 Primary Use Case: Protecting sensitive data on storage devices through robust encryption.
✨ Key Features: • Full system drive encryption • Encrypted partitions and non-system drives • Encrypted virtual disks • Plausible deniability with hidden volumes • Support for various encryption algorithms (AES, Serpent, Twofish)
📖 Summary: VeraCrypt is an open-source disk encryption software based on TrueCrypt, offering enhanced security features. It allows users to create encrypted volumes, partitions, or entire system drives to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 awesome-django | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a centralized and organized collection of high-quality resources and tools for Django developers.
✨ Key Features: • Curated list of third-party packages • Categorized resources for Django development • Includes official resources, educational materials, community links, and hosting options • Dedicated sections for Django REST Framework and Wagtail CMS
📖 Summary: Awesome Django is a curated list of resources and third-party packages for the Django web framework. It serves as a comprehensive guide for developers looking to enhance their Django projects with various tools and libraries.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 CyberScraper-2077 | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Intelligent and advanced web scraping with AI assistance for precise data extraction.
✨ Key Features: • AI-Powered Extraction • Streamlit Interface • Multi-Format Support (JSON, CSV, HTML, SQL, Excel) • Tor Network Support • Stealth Mode
📖 Summary: CyberScraper 2077 is an AI-powered web scraping tool that leverages LLMs like OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama to intelligently extract data from websites. It features a user-friendly Streamlit interface, supports multiple export formats, and includes advanced features like Tor network access, stealth mode, and captcha bypassing.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source
